text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The end of summer training camp had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... Yamanin Zephyr is nowhere
to be found at the training camp lodge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bus departure time is drawing near.
If she were anywhere, it'd probably be—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Frolicking among the whitecaps, gliding coolly across the water...
Hehe, the sea breeze is as carefree as ever today.
choice_data_list: I knew I'd find you here.
I knew I'd find you here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—I was saying my farewells.
To this sea, and to the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Everything I gained here... I will treasure and take home with me."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even the memories brought by the sudden gust.
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Parting brings sadness, but only for a brief moment.
I will surely send word on the wind."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...The battle to come.
I shall run like the wind, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'll whip up a wind...
that reaches far, far away, all the way to this very sea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Yamanin Zephyr's figure as she walked away
was as light as the wind.
